metadata.baslik: Take $90, Hold Out, or Counter? You Pick · Ep. 2
metadata.aciklama:
Nobody commented last time, so Mike picked the bike. Two torn tubes and one no-show buyer later, Brenda finally has an offer: $90 cash, today.
Take $90, hold out for $140, or counter at $115? Tell us in the comments.
Jake & Mike started with $100. The goal: $1,000,000. You decide the moves.

We may show winning comments on screen with your username. Prefer to stay anonymous? Just say so in your comment.

Fiction. Not financial advice. Voices and visuals are AI-generated.
